meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 对代码做深度安全审计：跑 OWASP Top 10 检查、扫描硬编码密钥、审查依赖 CVE，有 Solidity 时查合约；最后给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论，并把报告写到 docs/reviews/security-audit-{日期}.md。
howto.when: 在发布前、改动了认证/授权/数据处理的代码之后，或做定期安全审查、新增依赖与外部集成时触发。

say.note: 未指定范围时审计整个 src/ 目录

howto.what_en: Runs a deep security audit: OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, dependency CVEs, plus Solidity contracts if present. Gives an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict and writes docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a release, after code changes touching auth, authorization or data handling, for periodic reviews, or when adding new dependencies or integrations.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory when no scope is given.
